    Score Terms Against an Element Set with FDR Correction

    terms_ecset_statistics_fdr.Rd

    A convenience wrapper that performs enrichment analysis for a single set of elements. It calculates raw enrichment statistics AND computes Normalized Enrichment Scores (NES) and Empirical False Discovery Rates (FDR).

    terms_ecset_statistics_fdr(
  object,
  element_set,
  n_permutations = 1000,
  seed = NULL
)

# S4 method for class 'ECTermScoring'
terms_ecset_statistics_fdr(
  object,
  element_set,
  n_permutations = 1000,
  seed = NULL
)

    Arguments

    object

    An ECTermScoring object.

    element_set

    A character vector of element names.

    n_permutations

    Integer. The number of random sets to generate for the null distribution. Defaults to 1000.

    seed

    Integer (Optional). A random seed for reproducibility.

    Value

    A data.table containing the enrichment results, including:

    • term_id: The term identifier.

    • observed_edge_count: Number of edges between the set and the term.

    • log2_Anscombe_ratio: The effect size.

    • p_value: The raw RGGED p-value (fast approximation).

    • nes: Normalized Enrichment Score.

    • fdr_q_value: The empirical False Discovery Rate q-value.

    Returns NULL if no valid connected terms are found.

    Details

    This function enforces the "fast" lambda approximation method for both the real set and the random simulations.

    Methods (by class)

    • terms_ecset_statistics_fdr(ECTermScoring): Method for ECTermScoring objects.

    See also

    terms_ecset_statistics, calculate_ecset_fdr

    Examples

    data(sample_ects)
target_term <- "GO:0005787"
set_1 <- sample_ects@ecprob@adj[[target_term]]

# Run full analysis in one step
results <- terms_ecset_statistics_fdr(sample_ects, set_1, n_permutations = 100, seed = 123)
print(head(results))
#>       term_id      p_value       lambda observed_edge_count log2_Anscombe_ratio
#>        <char>        <num>        <num>               <int>               <num>
#> 1: GO:0005787 3.175706e-18 0.0008246619                   5           1.9190666
#> 2: GO:0006465 1.015388e-16 0.0016493238                   5           1.9174855
#> 3: GO:0019068 9.891048e-04 0.0009895943                   1           0.9353335
#>    set_size       nes fdr_q_value
#>       <int>     <num>       <num>
#> 1:        5 1.9190666 0.001335708
#> 2:        5 1.9174855 0.000667854
#> 3:        5 0.9353335 0.998664292
